STAGE RECORD 1 - design check before the answer.
GOAL: choose a hyperbolic SID-table quality metric that is not a re-expression of prefix count, collision rate, same-bucket ratio, or the already-refuted Voronoi/margin/adj-R2/hsoftmax/cover-radius/path-likelihood family.
READ: the task contract, the list of measured 97-pair results, and the note that partition-only geometry fails while reference-contrast metrics work. No data files were readable in this session (read permission denied), so the proposal is specified from the contract and the stated schema.
OBSERVED: the strongest existing signal is Q_H at level 1 (+0.634). The failures show that (a) level 2+ prefixes behave like item identifiers, (b) a plain path likelihood rewards collapse because it rises with -0.78 correlation to level-2 bucket count, and (c) single-anchor margins/tightness/coverage are already refuted.
REASONING: the new statistic should use the frozen reference as a contrast, but with three changes: a Frechet barycentre of the query's whole training history (plus its source point) as the query point; the full mass distribution of all level-1 cells rather than a ten-negative mean; and an item-mass percentile with the true cell counted at half mass, which has an exact symmetry null of 0.5 and therefore cannot reward putting everything in one large cell. Leave-one-out on the query target and on the true cell removes self-inclusion. The resulting scalar is 0.5 minus the mean mass percentile, so random and collapsed tables sit near 0, aligned fine tables near +0.5, anti-aligned tables near -0.5.
OPEN: none for the written proposal; the empirical check on the 97 pairs is the evaluator's step.

METRIC: hyp_massrank_l1
TITLE: Hyperbolic leave-one-out mass-rank percentile of the true level-1 SID cell.
FORMULA: N = number of items with a level-1 code and a target rep; K = number of level-1 codes; c_i in {1..K}; n_p = #{i:c_i=p}; P_train = training pairs. In the unit Poincare ball B^d, curvature -1, d_H(x,y)=arcosh(1+2||x-y||^2/((1-||x||^2)(1-||y||^2))). Bary(Z) = Frechet/Karcher barycentre argmin_z sum_i d_H(z,z_i)^2, computed in the Lorentz model by 20 iterations z<-exp_z(mean_i log_z(z_i)), init at the normalised Lorentzian sum, stop at step<1e-6; Bary(empty)=0. For pair (u,j), H_u={k:(u,k) in P_train}; q_{u,j}=Bary({s_u} union {t_k:k in H_u,k!=j}). For code p, b_p=Bary({t_i:c_i=p}) for p!=c_j, and b_{c_j}^{-j}=Bary({t_i:c_i=c_j,i!=j}); d_p=d_H(q_{u,j},b_p) with b_{c_j} replaced by b_{c_j}^{-j}; d_true=d_{c_j}. P_{u,j}=(1/N)[sum_{p:d_p<d_true} n_p + 0.5 n_{c_j} + 0.5 sum_{p!=c_j:d_p=d_true} n_p]. M=0.5-(1/|U|)sum_u (1/|H_u|)sum_{j in H_u} P_{u,j}; higher is better.
INPUTS: exported level-1 integer code per item; frozen Issue #126 s_i and t_i for every item (training-only reference); training split P_train. Nothing else.
GEOMETRY: unit Poincare ball curvature -1; all distances and all cell/query summaries are hyperbolic; curvature enters the d_H denominator and the Lorentz exp/log Karcher iteration. If the reference uses curvature -c_ref, rescale coordinates by sqrt(c_ref) first.
WHY IT SHOULD TRACK RECALL: P is the item-mass fraction ranked ahead of the true cell, true cell counted at half mass. A fine aligned table gives P~0, M~+0.5; random gives P~0.5, M~0; collapsed gives P~0.5, M~0 because the true cell's own mass dominates; anti-aligned gives P~1, M~-0.5. Adds over Q_H: full leave-one-out history barycentre as query point, full mass distribution over all K cells instead of ten negatives, and an exact symmetry baseline that cannot reward collapse.
COMPUTE: O(20dN) for cells, O(20d sum_u |H_u|^2) for query barycentres, O(|P_train|Kd) for distances. At N=24587, K<=256, d<=64 and 250k pairs with mean history 10, about 7 GFLOP; float32 vectorised, well under a minute. No fitting, no Stage-2/3 run, no permutation null.
RISKS: source and target reps must share one unit ball; long histories make LOO quadratic; near-origin reps cause ties and M~0; 0.5 baseline is conservative if the table was built from the reference; boundary overflow (use Lorentz, clamp ||x||<=1-1e-7); only level 1 is read.
FAILURE MODE: worst is the anti-aligned table, a fixed permutation sending each query's reference-nearest items to the farthest cell from its history barycentre, with small cells: true cell last, P~1, M~-0.5. Random balanced gives ~0; K=1 ties give 0 by convention; giant-cell-plus-singletons gives ~0 because the true cell's own mass dominates.
END METRIC
